vulnerabilities.evidence: Metrics show avg_tps of 1292.1366666666668 and max_tps of 1399.9333333333334, which are close to the identified spam bursts of 100k+ TPS that degrade network performance.
No specific evidence in metrics indicating abuse of the gossip protocol.
255 delinquent validators out of 793 total, which could indicate targeted vote censorship.
No specific evidence in metrics indicating slow patch adoption.

summary: The network is at high risk due to potential DDoS and spam attacks, as well as vote censorship. Gossip protocol abuse and slow patch adoption are also identified as medium risks.
